chunk.title: Ordering official transcripts
chunk.text:
# Ordering official transcripts

Order official transcripts through the **student portal** under *Records > Transcripts*.

- Electronic transcripts cost $10 each and usually arrive within 2 business days.
- Paper transcripts cost $15 each and are mailed within 5 business days.
- Unofficial transcripts are free and can be downloaded from the student portal at any time.

You cannot order a transcript while your account has a financial hold. Contact the Bursar's Office to clear a hold.

chunk.title: Student parking permits
chunk.text:
# Student parking permits

Buy a student parking permit online through the **parking portal** at parking.northgate.example.

- A semester permit costs $180, and a full-year permit costs $320.
- Commuter permits are valid in Lots C and D.
- Overnight parking requires a residential permit, which is only available to students living on campus.

Lost your permit? Report it in the parking portal. Replacements cost $25.

chunk.title: Connecting to campus Wi-Fi
chunk.text:
# Connecting to campus Wi-Fi

Students and staff should connect to **NU-Secure** and sign in with their NetID and password. NU-Secure is encrypted and works in every campus building.

Visitors can join **NU-Guest**. Guest access lasts 24 hours and needs a phone number to receive a one-time code.

Visiting students and researchers from other universities can use **eduroam** with their home institution's credentials.

Gaming consoles and smart TVs in residence halls must be registered at devices.northgate.example before they can connect.

chunk.title: Resetting your NetID password
chunk.text:
# Resetting your NetID password

Go to password.northgate.example and choose **Forgot password**. You need your Duo two-factor device to finish the reset.

- Reset links expire after 15 minutes. If your link expired, start the reset again.
- New passwords must be at least 14 characters and cannot reuse any of your last 5 passwords.
- After 10 failed sign-in attempts your account locks; the lock clears automatically after 30 minutes.

## Still stuck?

Call the IT Service Desk at 555-0100, or visit the walk-in desk in Library Room 120, Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm.
